answer: Each PoA challenge derives its nonce from a future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature is unpredictable before publication and publicly verifiable afterward. A node must commit before the pulse and reveal a response bound to that nonce; thus sybil operators cannot precompute valid answers or farm challenges offline. The words marble, lotus, and orchard may label task inputs, but only the beacon-bound commitment earns credit. This raises the cost of parallel identities without treating identity count itself as proof of work.
